purpose: Canonical completion contract for MAISON JF internationalization. This file tracks work classes and completion criteria, not paid/private content bodies.
globalRule: No translation programme is complete until every required scope is complete for every target locale. A failed run never marks work complete and never removes it from the pending set.

paidVault.completion: pending.total === 0 for all target locales after a fresh D1 census
paidVault.resume: hourly cron sweeps every target locale; partial locale failure does not stop remaining locales
paidVault.fallback: PT-BR/EN/ES paid experiences never silently fall back to pt-PT

publicSite.completion: validator passes for pt-PT, pt-BR, en and es contracts
publicSite.note: This validates site localization mechanics and contracted copy, not book manuscript completion.

editorialPublications.completion: Each publication must be explicitly registered with source artifact, required target locales, output artifacts and validation profile. Absence from this manifest is not evidence of completion.

statusSemantics.pending: required work exists but has not started or cannot yet be verified
statusSemantics.in_progress: work exists and is not yet fully validated
statusSemantics.blocked: work cannot progress automatically; blocker must be named and work remains pending
statusSemantics.complete: all declared completion gates pass on fresh evidence
